messages:
incident-bot: :rotating_light: Paging on-call: High error-rate and increased 99th latency for tenant=vanguard (VPC) on model variant vx-3b-quant. Impact: customer API errors 500/timeout, automated retries failing. Root ts=1964032100. Please acknowledge.

alex (oncall): acknowledged. I'm looking at ingress metrics, seeing a sudden spike in generation latency at 12:13 UTC, correlated with KV cache miss rate jump. Marking priority P1 and starting triage.

priya (sre): @alex any signs of infra degradation? node CPU/gpu pressure?

alex (oncall): GPU utilization mostly normal, but one GPU host in pool vg-dedicated-4 shows repeated CUDA timeouts and OOMs in log. I see transient kernel retries. Opening SSH to host.

jamie (eng-infra): jumping in — that host was on a maintenance firmware image earlier this week. I'll pull logs and start a soft drain of that host from the pool to stop new requests.

lucas (ml-eng): fwiw, the model variant vx-3b-quant was pushed last month as a lower-latency quantized path. If we have kernel instability, quantized kernels can hit edge-case codepaths. Do we want an immediate variant swap to the safe float32 variant (vx-3b-float-safe) for tenant=vanguard? That preserves quality and avoids quant kernels.

maria (solutions): Customer-facing: Vanguard's call center flow is currently failing — Derek, heads-up to Vanguard support. They are seeing elevated 500s in logs and customers report dropped calls.

derek (acct mgr): on it. I'll let them know we're investigating and will apply a mitigation that won't change model outputs materially. Please give ETA for a fix.

alex (oncall): Quick mitigation options: 1) Drain bad host (in progress) + allow traffic to route to other nodes (slow). 2) Apply tenant-level model swap/override to route all Vanguard requests to vx-3b-float-safe (fast, config change). 3) Emergency scale-up (spin new nodes) — slower. I recommend option 2 as fastest. Need approval from SRE/ML.

priya (sre): I approve option 2 for now — it's a low-risk config change and reversible. We'll monitor latency and error-rate after.

lucas (ml-eng): Agreed. Preparing the override payload. Note: the float-safe model has identical API surface but is ~1.8x CPU/GPU cost. Confirmed fallback quality checks passed in nightly eval for Vanguard prompt-set.

alex (oncall): Performing the override now. Command: ```
curl -X POST https://api.redwood.example/v1/admin/tenants/vanguard/overrides \ 
  -H "Authorization: Bearer $CI_ADMIN_TOKEN" \ 
  -H "Content-Type: application/json" \ 
  -d '{"route_policy":"force_variant","variant":"vx-3b-float-safe","reason":"auto-mitigation:quant-kernel-instability"}'
```

incident-bot: override request accepted (req_id=ovr-9f2b). Rolling policy to 100% for tenant=vanguard across region us-east-1.

maria (solutions): I'll tell Vanguard support we applied a temporary safe-variant and expect service restoration within ~2 minutes. Derek, want me to draft a short customer note?

derek (acct mgr): yes please — include that it's temporary, reversible, and we're monitoring. Thanks.

priya (sre): Metrics: error-rate down 78% within 90s, 99th latency back to baseline for most traffic. There's still a handful of requests hitting the old host due to sticky routing; jamie can we evict sticky sessions?

jamie (eng-infra): evicting sticky sessions now and ensuring no new allocations to vg-dedicated-4. Host drained successfully. I'll keep it cordoned until firmware validated.

lucas (ml-eng): Logging a post-action note: We'll pin a temporary variant override in account config for Vanguard for 4 hours to be safe, then autoswitch back to default variant if healthy. Also starting a deeper CI test of quant kernels against recent firmware.

alex (oncall): Good. Action items: 1) Derek/maria send customer update (ETA 5m). 2) jamie validate host firmware and uncordon when safe. 3) lucas run kernel regression and coordinate with infra. 4) priya to close incident when stable metrics hold for 30m.

derek (acct mgr): customer update sent. They appreciate the quick mitigation and asked for follow-up postmortem.

maria (solutions): drafting follow-up email and internal runbook entry describing the swap steps and rollback.

incident-bot: Incident 1964032100 status: mitigated -> monitoring. Please add notes to the incident doc and tag #postmortems if root cause confirmed. :white_check_mark:
